item.title: Senate Democrats blast Zeldin's EPA over proposal to roll back federal water protections
item.description: U.S. Senator Kirsten Gillibrand and 15 other Senate Democrats sent a letter to the EPA and Army Corps of Engineers rebuking a proposed rule that would limit federal water protections, arguing that it ignores science and threatens drinking water for millions of Americans.

item.title: 'Ice Out of Everywhere' protest draws crowd in Downtown Syracuse
item.description: Protestors gathered in Downtown Syracuse on Jan. 30 to call for changes to immigration enforcement policies, urging local and county leaders to not cooperate with federal immigration agencies and to pass the New York for All Act.

item.title: Oswego city crews working nonstop to clear snow after heavy storm
item.description: OSWEGO, N.Y. (WSYR-TV)-- Oswego city crews are working nonstop to clear streets following a round of heavy winter weather. The work involves plowing main roads and hauling snow away to clear the roads. Craig Rebeor, the city's commissioner of public works, said that the crews are prepared for this weather and are following regular protocol. [...]

item.title: Do you remember the Blizzard of 1966? It happened 60 years ago
item.description: The Blizzard of 1966 was a devastating snowstorm that struck Central New York, dropping 42.3 inches of snow in Syracuse and 103 inches in Oswego, causing strong winds and difficult snow removal.

item.title: Shadow or no shadow on Groundhog Day? Make your prediction of winter's fate
item.description: Punxsutawney Phil will make his prediction on Groundhog Day, February 2nd, based on whether or not he sees his shadow.

item.title: Tell Me Something Good: Syracuse Habitat for Humanity helps displaced Ukrainian family move into a new home
item.description: A Ukrainian family has found peace in Central New York after being displaced by the war, with the help of Habitat for Humanity and a group of volunteers.

item.title: Judge orders release of 5-year-old Minnesota boy, father detained by ICE
item.description: U.S. District Judge Fred Biery admonished the administration’s removal of Liam Conejo Ramos and his father, Adrian Conejo Arias, saying the pair “seek nothing but the modicum of due process and the rule of law.”
